copy.heading: The car boot
body: The boot of the family car is a shared space. It should hold the buggy, the nappy bag, the big shop and, on Sundays, the scooter. At present it holds your racket bag.

The racket bag contains two rackets, a spare racket, three tubes of balls, a grip, an overgrip, a towel, a second towel "for the second set", a protein bar from February and a pair of court shoes that should not be in an enclosed space. It is there "just in case a court comes up". Last month, a court came up twice. The buggy was needed nine times.
Lauren would like the buggy back in the boot. The racket bag can go on the back seat, between the car seats, where it can be closely watched by Mia.
